messages:
maria: Noticed an odd DX friction in the TypeScript sample app. Our typegen creates a return type based on the declared json_schema (object) but runtime tool sometimes emits an array of alternatives. The mismatch causes consumers to hit a runtime `TypeError` when they treat the value as object.

devon: can you share minimal repro? is typegen wrong or runtime too permissive?

maria: Minimal repro: schema is an object with `choice` property. typegen -> Promise<{ choice: string }>. Runtime tool returns `[ { choice: 'x' }, { choice: 'y' } ]`. IDE + compile-time types encourage `resp.choice` access and it explodes at runtime.

oliver: This is rough for onboarding—new devs expect types to match runtime. Two potential fixes: (1) change typegen to support union types (object | Array<object>) when schema allows multiple; (2) require tool authors to wrap multiple results in an explicit envelope, e.g., `{ variants: [...] }`.

maria: Also auth/retry: when helper throws on unexpected shape, our retry middleware replays the call (it treats helper-thrown errors as transient). That causes side-effects in some sample-app flows. We should make shape-mismatch a terminal client error and not retry.

devon: Agreed on non-retry for schema mismatch. For types, maybe generate a `TToolResult` generic and if schema has top-level `type: ["object","array"]` or `oneOf` we can map to union. But keep default strict to avoid hiding issues.

oliver: Suggest adding an SDK runtime check with a helpful error message that includes the received shape and a suggested fix (e.g., link to sample-app docs). Also add a `sdk.allowShapeCoercion` opt-in flag that will convert array -> envelope `{ variants: arr }` for backward compatibility in onboarding tutorials.

maria: I'll open a small RFC in docs and a PR to the TS typegen to emit `object | object[]` when schema is ambiguous. Also will update middleware to treat `SchemaValidationError` as non-retryable.

ops-bot: [ops] automated alert: duplicate side-effect run detected for sample-app on 2026-03-15 11:02:xx. Investigating.

devon: Please include a unit test for typegen + runtime integration and an e2e that asserts only one tool invocation when a shape mismatch occurs (no retry).

maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex-samples/pull/1234 (typegen + README updates). Tagging @devex @eng-runtime.

oliver: Thanks. Also add a short cookbook entry: "If you want multiple alternatives, use { variants: [] } or explicitly declare array in schema so typegen emits the right union."

maria: Will add. :white_check_mark:
